output.summary:
Alcohol by Vol: 58.0%

Barrel proof straight bourbon whiskey distilled in Indiana (MGP) and bottled in Bardstown, KY, by Proof and Wood · Mash bill of 75% corn, 21% rye, 4% malted barley · Aged a minimum 4 years · Small batch, blended from approximately 20 barrels · Nose of tree bark and crème pâtissière; browned butter and violet on the mid-palate with an earthy finish that hints of licorice root, tobacco, and bitter herbs · Non-chill filtered; 57.4% ABV (ABV may vary batch to batch)

Distilled in Indiana from the same mash bill as Proof and Wood’s Deadwood Bourbon, this distinct and sultry bourbon is a must-try for those that love barrel-strength expressions.
